en.title: Transcribe recordings
en.description: Convert audio to text with optional speaker labels using OpenAI’s API.
tasks: Convert audio to text with optional speaker labels using OpenAI’s API.
prerequisites: Python, openai, OPENAI_API_KEY. Upstream CLI uses $CODEX_HOME/skills/transcribe/.
en.example: Use transcribe. Transcribe this interview with speaker labels and flag words that need manual review.
en.expectedResult: A transcript or diarized JSON aligned with the supplied recording.
limitations: Audio is sent to the API and incurs usage costs; verify names and speaker attribution.

zh.title: 转录录音
zh.description: 通过 OpenAI API 将音频转为文本，并可添加说话人标签。
tasks: 通过 OpenAI API 将音频转为文本，并可添加说话人标签。
zh.example: 请使用 transcribe：转录这段访谈，标注说话人并指出需要人工核对的词语。
zh.expectedResult: 与录音对应的转录稿或带说话人信息的 JSON。
limitations: 音频会发送至 API 并计费；需核对姓名和说话人归属。
